implemented_intro: Acquired current 2026/27 Premier League team and player data, with historical opponents retained as context.
Built chronological home/draw/away match-probability models from team statistics, xG and FPL player histories.
Replayed 116 distinct trading strategies from separate 100,000-unit accounts on common 2025/26 fixtures, with full trading and risk metrics.
Exported reproducible models, predictions, money curves, source-date audits, reports and timestamped prospective forecast ledgers.

graph_definitions.warning: Accounts combine probability model, outcome/edge rules, price source and staking. Do not call all 116 distinct fitted algorithms.

model_selection_warning: Use explicit observed criterion and common sample. Historical best return is not prospective validated best. Raw Bet365 has best pooled proper probability scores in the completed rolling study; this is a market benchmark, not a learned model.

prospective.duplicate_review_ledger_warning: Reviewed and initial player-model export ledgers are the exact same 80 records; do not count them twice.

limitations: Repeatedly examined 2022/23-2025/26 results are exploratory; chronological fitting does not create a fresh historical holdout.
Best individual-book archived quotes have unverified capture clocks and availability; no executable fills or arbitrage is established.
Model-implied expected gain/loss depend on estimated probabilities and are different from realized average wins/losses.
Projected XI uses earlier positive-minute appearances and fixed role slots; it is not a confirmed lineup or injury/availability feed.
Some season-fixed position proxies have unverified original publication times.
Missing or early-season player histories remain with coverage controls and training-fitted missing-value handling; no population dropping in primary comparison.
Most cashflow uncertainty estimates condition on recorded bets/stakes and do not capture full refitting, selection or multiple-comparison uncertainty.
Ten resolved prospective fixtures are insufficient to choose a winning model.
